/-- Model of `loans.py`: dates are day numbers, so `timedelta(days=n)` is `+ n`. -/
inductive Kind | novel | magazine | dvd | tool | reference
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def loanDays : Kind → Nat
  | .novel => 21 | .magazine => 21 | .dvd => 21 | .tool => 21 | .reference => 3

def dueDate (k : Kind) (checkedOut : Nat) : Nat := checkedOut + loanDays k

#eval dueDate .tool 0       -- 21
#eval dueDate .reference 0  -- 3

/-- Claim c2: every kind but reference gets 21 days; reference gets 3. Any check-out day. -/
theorem c2_policy (d : Nat) :
    (∀ k, k ≠ Kind.reference → dueDate k d = d + 21) ∧ dueDate .reference d = d + 3 := by
  refine ⟨fun k hk => ?_, rfl⟩
  cases k <;> first | rfl | exact absurd rfl hk
EOF
